prompt_replacements.new: that ambiguity. Write instance_kind, row_identity_basis, row_identity_role, then value. row_identity_basis states whether the supplied entity is the qualifying row or a different entity related to it. qualifying_row_identity means the reference identifies one of the rows named by candidate_kind. related_entity_identity means the reference identifies a different entity related to each qualifying row. The value contains the copied operand and its origin.
